provenance.implementation_boundary: source equity volatility mechanism adapted to the complete local Binance USD-M symbol x timeframe eligible universe; source-reported equity results are not claimed

universe.source_universe: 1,027 U.S. equities plus 1,552 Japanese TSE Prime equities; daily OHLCV, December 2015-November 2025
universe.selection: complete local eligible universe for the registered OHLCV core mechanism; no symbol drop

data.venue: Binance USD-M perpetual canonical raw archive
data.point_in_time: canonical raw snapshot; no future data beyond registered end
data.missing_data: fail closed on non-contiguous bars at every registered frequency; no gap fill

regime_state: 20-day CAPM-residual idiosyncratic RV with 120-day causal beta
signal_registration.architecture: two-hidden-layer width-16 GELU base MLP with registered dropout p=0.10, frozen before residual experts; two residual experts with soft state-dependent routing
signal_registration.training: full-batch Adam; feature normalization and all rolling quantities use the training prefix only
signal_registration.formation: each registered timeframe close; execution at next registered bar open
signal_registration.position_mapping: long the cross-sectional high forecast-volatility tail and short the low tail; fresh sign change opens an episode
signal_registration.causality: no feature, regime, normalization or model fit reads a bar after the decision timestamp

parameter_domain.selection_rule: historical-only selector: episodes floor, net_pnl > 0, Sharpe > 0, then OOS/full/stress and legal DCA neighbourhood

robustness_plan.baseline: frozen base-only forecast is disclosed as an ablation surface; no post-hoc gate uses it

split.rule: chronological; frozen model fit prefix-only; OOS is read-only

costs.funding: official/modelled raw settlements charged by containing daily bar; cost-only

registered_family_level_falsification.note: Falsification readers are measured and disclosed; they do not shrink the local eligible universe and cannot be silently converted into a PASS gate.
items: net execution cost erasing volatility-dispersion signal

row_match_recipe.equality: exact, numeric == float compare; labels bytewise
